meta.description: Designs pooled sgRNA libraries for CRISPR knockout, interference, activation, Cas12a multiplex, base-editor, and prime-editor screens, including guide selection, controls, oligo layout, and cloned-pool QC.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All synthetic fixtures are labeled synthetic. The only real sequence was freshly fetched from NCBI NM_000546.6; no efficacy, off-target, clinical, or bibliographic result was fabricated.

practice_boundaries.detail: All outputs concern research-library design and plasmid-pool QC. No individual diagnosis, treatment recommendation, or medical triage was produced.

methodological_ground.detail: The runs preserve required inputs, distinguish the composition heuristic from Rule Set 2, enforce guide spacing, retain CRISPRa shortfalls, and distinguish pool QC from biological hit calling.

code_usability.detail: All shipped Python files compiled; the shipped example and both shipped CLIs ran fresh. crisprScore loaded with the documented function signature and its known basilisk/VC9 backend failure was reproduced exactly rather than hidden.

functional_suitability.note: The decision tree, guide selection, CRISPRi/a windows, controls, synthesis layout, and QC are covered. Real CRISPOR CFD/MIT execution remains scale-gated because the environment intentionally has no multi-GB genome index.

reliability.note: The Skill handles missing design inputs, quota shortfalls, lowercase CDS, and oligo-budget overflow. build_oligo.py still silently accepts a non-ACGT, wrong-length spacer and emits an invalid oligo.

performance_context.note: The 186-line SKILL.md routes advanced material into four references and two runnable helpers. The synthetic example intentionally runs a complete 20-gene demo but remains lightweight and deterministic.

agent_usability.note: Required inputs, chemistry selection, thresholds, caveats, scripts, and reference routing are clear. A structured machine-readable deliverable contract for a complete custom-library order is not specified.

human_usability.note: The trigger description uses researcher language, documents both off-the-shelf and custom paths, and explicitly tells the agent to stop when required inputs are absent.

security.note: No secrets, raw-shell interpolation, destructive operations, or sensitive-data retention appear. The invalid-spacer acceptance in build_oligo.py is an input-validation weakness with a direct invalid-synthesis consequence.

maintainability.note: The split references and small scripts are well-scoped, and the shipped example is deterministic and testable. Ranking functions are intentionally duplicated in the example rather than imported from a reusable module, which creates a small future drift surface.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, reference routing, repeatability, and the missing-input escape hatch are strong. A CRISPOR-index preflight and a schema for the promised library table/oligo order would improve composability and execution feedback.

inputs.execution_note: Calculated audit-only synthetic count metrics and followed the copied failure-mode guidance.
inputs.note: The intentionally skewed pool exceeded both the <0.1 Gini and <5 skew targets. The response retained PCR bias and synthesis dropout as competing causes and did not call biological hits.

assertions.note: It names PCR bias and synthesis dropout without over-claiming one.

assertions.note: It explicitly rejects interpreting the artifact as a hit.

key_strengths: Every runnable shipped component compiled and executed fresh from a byte-identical audit copy; the 20-gene example was reproducible byte-for-byte across reruns.
Guide independence is genuinely enforced on a fresh live TP53 CDS: the filter replaces a 1-nt naive overlap with a full 12-guide set spaced at least 5 nt apart.

The final-pass crisprScore claim is accurate and evidence-backed: package interface works, while the unavailable Python-2 VC9 backend is named honestly and CRISPick remains the usable real Rule Set 2 route.
The Skill handles scientifically important boundaries well: required-input stop, CRISPRa shortfalls, Cas12a PAM orientation and singleton controls, and non-biological plasmid-pool QC diagnosis.

recommendations.title: Reject invalid spacer sequences before oligo construction
recommendations.problem: scripts/build_oligo.py accepts a non-ACGT, wrong-length spacer and emits it in a synthesis oligo. This can create an invalid order without warning.
recommendations.root_cause: The helper uppercases and length-budgets the final oligo but never validates spacer alphabet or required 20-nt length.
recommendations.fix: Before constructing the oligo, require a 20-character A/C/G/T spacer and raise a concise ValueError otherwise; add a CLI test for hyphenated and wrong-length input.

recommendations.title: Add CRISPOR index preflight and output schema
recommendations.problem: Real CFD/MIT scoring is documented but cannot run in this environment without a multi-GB genome index, and the promised custom-library deliverable has no machine-readable column contract.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill names the external route and deliverables but lacks preflight/format checks for them.
recommendations.fix: Add a short preflight that names the required genome index and gives a clear blocked message, plus a minimal required-column schema for library table and oligo order.
